description: This file implements the Biquad class, which provides functionality for a digital biquad filter including initialization and calculation of filtered values.

classes.name: Biquad
classes.description: A class representing a biquad digital filter with state variables and methods for initialization and value calculation.

methods.name: Biquad()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes filter coefficients and state variables to zero.

methods.name: void initValue(float input DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SUFFIX)
